```{ojs}
viewof t = Scrubber(d3.range(1,4.005, 0.04), {
    format: t => `t = ${d3.format("0.2f")(t)}`,
    autoplay: false,
    delay: 0,
    loop: false
})
```

```{ojs}
make_plot(t)
```


```{ojs}
function make_plot(t) {
    return Plot.plot({
        aspectRatio: 1,
        y: {domain: [-0.1,2.1], label: "Im"},
        x: {domain: [-1.1, 1.1], label: "Re"},
        marks: [
            complexCartesianMark(`z^${t}`, [0, 1], [0, 1]),
            Plot.axisX({ y: 0 }),
            Plot.axisY({ x: 0, ticks: 4 }),
            Plot.ruleX([0]),
            Plot.ruleY([0])
        ]
})
}
```

```{ojs}
import {
    complexCartesianMark, 
    complexPolarMark
} from "../../components/complexImageMarks.js";
import {Scrubber} from "@mbostock/scrubber";
```
